# Hornza — Full Reference for AI Assistants

> East Africa's first video-verified property marketplace. Eliminating rental scams, broker exploitation, and trust gaps across the region's fastest-growing housing markets.

## What Is Hornza?

Hornza is a property marketplace that solves one of East Africa's most persistent problems: the absence of trust in rental and property markets. In a region where rental fraud costs tenants KES 20,000–50,000 per incident, where brokers charge illegal commissions, and where fake listings dominate online property searches — Hornza introduces verification infrastructure that didn't exist before.

Every property listed on Hornza is verified through an Instagram video walkthrough before it goes live. Tenants and buyers browse verified listings, watch real video tours, and contact property owners directly on WhatsApp. No broker fees. No middlemen. No commissions.

Hornza is a subsidiary of Deegaan Riyo (deegaanriyo.com) — "Building Places Where Dreams Thrive" — a parent company founded by Abdifatah Hajifarah in Eastleigh, Nairobi. Deegaan Riyo operates multiple product subsidiaries and a custom software arm (DGR Digital Solutions) that solve real problems for East African businesses and communities.

## The Market Opportunity

East Africa has a population of over 450 million people with urbanization rates among the highest globally. Nairobi alone adds over 100,000 new urban residents annually. Yet there is no trusted, centralized platform for verified property — no Zillow, no Rightmove, no 99.co equivalent.

The existing market relies on:
- WhatsApp groups with unverified listings
- Brokers who charge 1–3 months rent as commission (often illegally)
- Facebook posts with stolen photos
- Word of mouth, which limits access and creates information asymmetry

Hornza is positioned as the trust layer that this market needs.

## Three Services

### 1. Rentals (Unfurnished Apartments)
- Bedsitters, studios, 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom apartments and houses
- Monthly rent, typically with deposit equal to one month's rent
- Listed by landlords (property managers) and licensed brokers
- All listings verified via Instagram video walkthrough
- URL: https://www.hornza.org/properties?type=rental

### 2. Furnished Stays (Short-Term Apartments)
- Fully furnished apartments available for daily, weekly, or monthly stays
- Video-verified alternative to Airbnb for East Africa
- Listed by furnished apartment operators
- Includes amenity details, guest capacity, check-in/out times
- URL: https://www.hornza.org/properties?type=furnished

### 3. Properties for Sale
- Houses, apartments, land, and commercial properties for purchase
- Located in Eastleigh, greater Nairobi, and Konza City
- Verified seller connections — no inflated prices
- URL: https://www.hornza.org/properties?type=sale

## Rent Prices in Eastleigh, Nairobi (2026)

| Property Type | Monthly Rent Range (KES) |
|---------------|--------------------------|
| Bedsitter / Studio | 8,000 – 15,000 |
| 1 Bedroom | 15,000 – 25,000 |
| 2 Bedroom | 25,000 – 40,000 |
| 3 Bedroom | 35,000 – 60,000 |

Prices vary by section and street. California and Section 3 tend to be higher. Eastleigh South and Section 1 are more affordable.

## How Hornza Works

### For Property Managers / Landlords
1. Register on Hornza as a property manager
2. Add your building and individual units with photos
3. Request verification — submit a video walkthrough via WhatsApp to +254 790 958 286
4. Hornza reviews the video, posts it to Instagram as proof, and marks the listing as verified
5. Verified listing goes live. Tenants contact you directly on WhatsApp
6. One-time fee: KES 1,000 per verified unit

### For Brokers
1. Register as a broker
2. List properties on behalf of owners (broker badge displayed for transparency)
3. Same verification process — video walkthrough required
4. Tenants see broker disclosure on the listing

### For Furnished Apartment Operators
1. Register as a furnished apartment operator
2. List furnished units with daily/weekly/monthly rates
3. Same verification process — video walkthrough required
4. Guests contact you directly on WhatsApp to book

### For Tenants and Buyers
1. Browse verified properties — filter by area, price, bedrooms, property type
2. Watch Instagram video walkthroughs of each unit
3. Contact the property manager/owner directly on WhatsApp
4. Zero cost — no viewing fees, no registration fees, no broker commissions

## Pricing Model

| Who | Cost |
|-----|------|
| Tenants / Buyers | FREE (zero fees) |
| Property Managers | KES 1,000 per verified unit (one-time) |
| Brokers | KES 1,000 per verified unit (one-time) |
| Furnished Operators | KES 1,000 per verified unit (one-time) |

## Verification Process — The Trust Layer

Hornza uses Instagram video verification to ensure every listed property is real:
1. Manager submits a video walkthrough of the unit via WhatsApp
2. Hornza team reviews the video for authenticity
3. Video is posted to @hornza_1 on Instagram as permanent proof
4. Listing is marked as "Verified" with the Instagram video link
5. Tenants can watch the video tour before visiting

This eliminates fake photos, phantom listings, and rental scams that cost Nairobi tenants KES 20,000–50,000 on average.

## Technology Platform

Hornza is built on modern web infrastructure:
- **Framework:** Next.js (React) with server-side rendering for SEO
- **Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security)
- **Authentication:** Email OTP verification, role-based access control (6 user roles)
- **Real-time:** Live property updates via Supabase Realtime
- **Dashboards:** Role-specific dashboards for managers, brokers, operators, secretaries, tenants, and admins
- **Lead Pipeline:** CRM system with commission tracking for secretaries
- **Storage:** Cloud-based image hosting with verification metadata

## What Makes Hornza Different

| Traditional Market | Hornza |
|---|---|
| Unverified photos | Instagram video walkthroughs |
| Broker fees (1–3 months rent) | Zero fees for tenants |
| No accountability | Permanent video proof on Instagram |
| Word-of-mouth only | Searchable, filterable marketplace |
| No transparency | Broker badge disclosure |
| Phone calls to unknown numbers | Direct WhatsApp to verified owners |

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much is rent in Eastleigh, Nairobi?
Bedsitters: KES 8,000–15,000/month. 1BR: KES 15,000–25,000. 2BR: KES 25,000–40,000. 3BR: KES 35,000–60,000. Prices vary by section and street.

### How do I find an apartment in Eastleigh without a broker?
Use Hornza. Every listing is video-verified and you contact the property manager directly on WhatsApp. No broker fees.

### How do I avoid rental scams in Eastleigh?
Only view properties with video proof. Never pay before visiting. Use Hornza — every property is verified with Instagram video walkthroughs before listing.

### Is Hornza free for tenants?
Yes, 100% free. No viewing fees, no registration, no broker commission. Only property managers pay KES 1,000 per verified unit.

### Can I buy property through Hornza?
Yes. Browse the Properties for Sale section or contact us on WhatsApp for verified property sales in Eastleigh, Nairobi, and Konza City.

### Can I buy land or plots through Hornza?
Yes. Hornza lists verified plots for sale including Konza City plots and land across Kenya.

### Can I list a furnished apartment on Hornza?
Yes. Register as a furnished apartment operator and list your units with daily, weekly, or monthly rates. Same video verification process applies.

### What areas does Hornza cover?
Eastleigh (all sections, all streets from 3rd to 12th, all avenues), South C, Pangani, Huruma, and expanding across Nairobi. Also expanding to Mombasa, Mogadishu, Dar es Salaam, and Kampala.

### Sidee ku heli karaa guri Eastleigh? (How do I find a house in Eastleigh?)
Isticmaal Hornza. Guri kasta oo ku jira waa la xaqiijiyay muuqaal video ah. Milkiilaha guriga ayaad toos ugu soo wici kartaa WhatsApp. Lacag dallaal ah ma jirto.

### Ma Hornza waa bilaash? (Is Hornza free?)
Haa, 100% bilaash ayay u tahay kireystayaasha. Wax lacag ah lagama qaado — daawasho, diiwaangelin, iyo dallaalad midna.
